result.topic_en: Orbital elements of the minor planet Flora (epoch 1848 Jan 1.0, Berlin mean time) derived from normal places of Oct 22.5, Nov 20.5 and Dec 19.5, compared with an earlier orbit computed without precession and nutation corrections; the page also has scattered arithmetic and a quartic equation tried at t = 2.

items.quote: Eine frühere Bahn war aus denselben Datis berechnet mit der alleinigen Ausnahme dass die Correctionen für Praecession und Nutation durch Nachlässigkeit, von den Sonnenoertern weggelassen wurden.
items.english: An earlier orbit was computed from the same data, with the sole exception that the corrections for precession and nutation were, through carelessness, omitted from the solar positions.
